source_instruction: i would like a 8 ft 6 in x 12 ft rectangular navy rug for my living room.
query:
Hey, I had the wildest little walk over to your shop today! I stopped first at the corner community garden to say hi to the retired guy who tends the sunflower patch out front, and he handed me a handful of the cheeriest bright yellow zinnia seeds he saved from last year’s blooms, said they’ll grow tall enough to peek right over my porch railing if I plant them in the next two weeks. Right after that, a tiny fluffy calico cat darted out from under a parked bakery delivery truck, rubbed all over my sneakers like we were long lost best friends, and followed me half a block before it peeled off to chase a sparrow that hopped across the sidewalk. I even popped into the little used bookstore on the next block for two minutes on my way over, and found a beat-up 90s paperback copy of my favorite childhood camping mystery novel tucked between two tattered cookbooks, for only 75 cents, so that already made my whole day feel like a win before I even got to your door.
I’m looking for a nice area rug for my living room, navy color, rectangular shape, you know, that one size I always get for that space? Since it seems like the rectangular cut is totally unavailable right now, I guess I’ll just go with whatever other shape you’ve got that fits the vibe, yeah? I don’t want to spend too much, so just show me options that don’t cost an arm and a leg, nothing crazy expensive, thanks so much!
